_about: Phase 3 failure-mode codebook, pre-registered 2026-11-21 before any reference label or method output existed. Written from FDA problem-term frequencies (all reports) and 7 example narratives per code drawn OUTSIDE the reference sample. One PRIMARY mode per report: the device problem or clinical reason that made someone file the report; if several are named, the most specific cause in 'priority' order wins (a cause beats its symptom: 'revised for pain due to loosening' = loosening). '*_OTHER' = no identifiable failure mode, insufficient information, or a reason outside the list.

O_INFECTION.definition: Infection around the hip or knee implant (periprosthetic joint infection): revision, spacer, irrigation and debridement, or antibiotics because of infection.

O_DEVICE_FRACTURE.definition: An implant component (stem, liner, insert, post, shell, tray, head) broke, cracked, fractured or dissociated from its mating part, in or out of the patient.

O_BONE_FRACTURE.definition: The patient's bone around the implant fractured (periprosthetic fracture), e.g. femur, tibia, patella or acetabulum.

O_INSTABILITY.definition: The joint dislocated, subluxed or was unstable or lax; includes malposition or malalignment causing instability.

O_LOOSENING.definition: The implant came loose from bone or failed to grow into or fix to bone (aseptic loosening, lack of osseointegration, subsidence, migration).

O_WEAR.definition: Wear of bearing surfaces or a reaction to wear debris or metal: polyethylene wear, osteolysis, metallosis, adverse local tissue reaction, corrosion, elevated metal ions.

O_INTRAOP.definition: A problem during surgery or handling before implantation: component would not seat or lock, difficult insertion, wrong size, packaging or sterility problem, trial or instrument issue.
O_INTRAOP.keywords: WOULD NOT (LOCK|SEAT|FIT)|DID NOT (LOCK|SEAT|FIT)|UNABLE TO (INSERT|SEAT|LOCK|IMPACT)|DIFFICULT\w* TO (INSERT|IMPACT|SEAT)|INTRA-?OPERATIV|PACKAG|STERIL|WRONG SIZE|INCORRECT SIZE|\bTRIAL\b

O_PAIN_STIFFNESS.definition: Pain, stiffness, arthrofibrosis or reduced range of motion with no more specific cause named.

O_OTHER.definition: No identifiable failure mode, insufficient information, revision for an unknown reason, or a reason outside this list (e.g. blood clots, literature summaries).

C_PREVENTIVE.definition: Device explanted or replaced as a precaution because of an advisory, field safety notice or recall, with no malfunction observed in this device.

C_INFECTION_POCKET.definition: Infection, pocket erosion, hematoma or sepsis related to the implant site.

C_BATTERY.definition: Battery depleting early, reaching ERI/end of life early, or an unexpected battery or longevity reading.

C_LEAD_CAPTURE.definition: Pacing not reaching the heart: high or low impedance, loss of capture, high threshold, lead dislodgement or fracture, header or connection problem, no pacing.

C_SENSING.definition: The device sensed the wrong signals: over-sensing, under-sensing, noise or artifact, leading to wrong pacing or inappropriate therapy.

C_TELEMETRY_SOFTWARE.definition: Communication, interrogation, telemetry, programming, software or firmware problem, unexpected reset or back-up mode, wrong data or display.

C_OTHER.definition: No identifiable failure mode, insufficient information, or a reason outside this list.

D_LEAK.definition: Insulin leaked from the pump, pod, reservoir or infusion site.

D_OCCLUSION_DELIVERY.definition: Insulin flow blocked or delivered wrongly: occlusion alarm, blockage, under- or over-delivery, delivery stopped.

D_CANNULA_INSERTION.definition: The needle or cannula did not deploy, deployed early, bent, kinked or was not inserted properly.

D_ADHESIVE_DISLODGED.definition: The pod or infusion set came off the body or was dislodged: adhesive failed, peeled, fell or was knocked off.
D_ADHESIVE_DISLODGED.keywords: ADHES|CAME OFF|FELL OFF|DISLODG|PEEL|NOT STICK|KNOCKED OFF|PULLED OFF

D_SKIN.definition: Skin reaction at the infusion site: irritation, rash, itching, redness, allergy or site infection.

D_ALARM_ELECTRONICS.definition: Pump or pod electronics: fault or error alarm, battery, button, display, power, software or app, controller or communication, overheating, motor or drive problem, missing history.

D_OTHER.definition: No identifiable failure mode (e.g. high blood glucose with no device problem named), insufficient information, or a reason outside this list.

fda_term_map._about: Method M1: FDA device and patient problem terms -> mode. Generic terms (no device problem identified, insufficient information, no clinical signs) are ignored. If a report carries terms for several modes, the family's priority order decides; none -> *_OTHER.
